Subject: Everlane — quick 30m demo next week?

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. Based on our conversation it sounds like a focused 30-minute demo of our inference runtime and cost/latency projections for your ingestion pipeline would be the best next step. Are you available for 30 minutes on Tuesday 12/7 at 11:00am PT or Wednesday 12/8 at 10:00am PT?

If neither works I can send a short async walkthrough and the deck. I'll include Aditya from our solutions team on the call to go over throughput/quantization options.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

neha.kapoor@redwood.example.com | (415) 555-0163

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@everlane.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@everlane.ai>, procurement@everlane.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Everlane — quick 30m demo next week?

Neha —

Appreciate you reaching out and the proposal. I wanted to share an update from my side: we had an all-hands with the GTM and product orgs yesterday and leadership asked us to pause a number of exploratory infrastructure pilots while we reallocate headcount and cloud budget toward a payments/fulfillment reliability program for Q1.

That means we need to deprioritize the inference pilot for the near term. I'm traveling next week and won't be able to join a demo, and even when I return there won't be capacity to run an evaluation until the reorg settles.

That said, I still think the problem you showed (token cost + tail latency) is real for us. Can we put the demo on hold for now? I'd like to keep the deck and SOW on file and circle back in ~2–3 months. I've cc'd Olivia and procurement so they have the materials.

Thanks — Samir
VP, Platform Engineering
Everlane AI

If it helps while you're in travel / reorg, we can: 
- Share a 10-minute recorded walkthrough that highlights the latency/cost tradeoffs (I'll send the link),
- Provide an estimated cost delta model scoped to the ingestion profile you shared, or
- Set a lightweight 15-minute check-in for early February to see if priorities have settled.

Which option would be most useful to you? No rush — we'll keep the deal in "On Hold" stage and I'll flag the timing in HubSpot per your note.
